# moddotplot-interactive v0.8.0

**Note:** This file was generated by ChatGPT 5.6 Sol under the direction of Adam Phillippy.

v0.8.0 improves the launch, grid-navigation, preview, and color-selection workflows
and adopts `moddotplot-interactive` as the release-facing project name. The release
remains a functional preview. See the [validation record](v0.8.0/VALIDATION.md) for
completed and pending verification.

## Launch workflow

The launch screen now separates sequence and annotation input. The primary target
accepts FASTA, gzip FASTA, and BGZF FASTA. A smaller target beneath it accepts BED,
GFF, and GTF annotations, including supported compressed variants.

Loading a viewable sequence set reveals a green **Explore** button. File selection and
parsing remain on the launch screen; plot preparation and the active DNA-helix state
begin only after the user chooses **Explore**.

When one staged annotation file contains records for several loaded FASTA sequences,
it is read once and partitioned by exact identifier or a uniquely resolved conservative
chromosome alias. Ambiguous aliases are skipped rather than duplicated, and alias-only
associations still require confirmation.

## Grid continuity and preview quality

Opening a grid cell still transfers its records into the full interactive Self or
Pairwise plot. That view now includes **Back to grid**, which restores the same grid
overview, selections, and completed comparisons rather than making the user recreate
the grid. The completed data and canvases are retained only for that return flow;
leaving it releases the grid resources.

Grid previews increase from 256 by 256 to 512 by 512 cells to reduce visible blur.
They remain serial and resource bounded, and they do not start the full interactive
refinement pipeline for every cell. The six-sequence limit remains unchanged: its 6
self plots and 15 unique pairwise plots require 21 computations, while mirrored
canvases fill the opposite triangle.

## Color controls and defaults

Similarity palettes now use the [ColorBrewer 2](https://colorbrewer2.org/) catalog:
18 sequential, 9 diverging, and 8 qualitative schemes grouped by family. A separate
color-count control lets the user select only the discrete class counts supported by
the active scheme; its minimum and maximum update when the palette changes. All
schemes begin at 3 colors. Sequential schemes reach 9, diverging schemes reach 11, and
qualitative maxima are 8, 9, or 12 depending on the scheme. The chosen colors are
rendered as that exact number of discrete identity classes.

The initial similarity style is now 11-color Spectral on a true white (`#ffffff`) plot
background. Empty and loading plot surfaces remain white; selecting black applies it
only within published tile bounds. Palette and background changes continue to recolor
cached numerical results without rerunning the sequence calculation.

## Presentation and project identity

The Export image button label has been adjusted to fit its control. The release-facing
application, private npm package, archives, citation metadata, SBOM component, and
repository references are now named `moddotplot-interactive`.

The internal Rust packages remain `moddotplot-core` and `moddotplot-wasm`. Preserving
those established crate names avoids an unnecessary breaking change to Rust imports,
build commands, and generated Wasm bindings.
